text: Appeal of Order to Comply (April 17, 2018) for 129 Midland Avenue.

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply, dated April 17, 2018, for 129 Midland Avenue, Folder No: 18 145104 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to November 30, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
